spoken.text: This week's verse is Acts, chapter 2, verse 42. In our own words: The first believers kept learning, sharing meals and praying together.
This week's verse is Acts, chapter 2, verse 42. In our own words: The first believers kept learning, sharing meals and praying together.

This week's story: Wind, fire and a bright light. God’s Spirit came like wind and fire, and thousands of people believed when Peter preached. Stephen was brave right to the end, and Jesus stopped Saul on the road with a bright light and changed him.
